title: Refresher second storm without Kevlar/Unstoppable
question: Does the Refresher storm get Diviner's Kevlar's barrier and +40 spirit (40 s cooldown) and keep Escalating Exposure stacks from the first storm?
hypothesis: H-L6: second storm has no Kevlar barrier/spirit and no Unstoppable (60 s), Infuser only from 30 s; damage ~96% of the first because EE stacks (12 s x duration) carry over.

setup.position: mid lane, bots on a 300 u ring (inside the 40 m storm)

controls: Same position and spawn distance (enemies 3 at 300 u ring, main target 350 u)
hardreset between blocks (fresh cooldowns, no items)
Same souls/level/ability tiers (unlock 7) in every arm except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP keep-alive (ekeep 0.9) and resists
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B; A/A floor run first
procedure: give items; enemies 3 300 8; cast 4 23; cast refresher; mods; cast 4 23; mods

decision.rule: ratio >= 0.9 and no Kevlar on storm 2 supports the anti-synergy note (Refresher stays rich-only)
